reference: draft-hawkins-scitt-attested-agent-payment-01, Section 4, Check 8 (funds-authority clause); Section 3 (Authorization Scope CDDL)

claim_boundary.instantiation: This profile is EMILIA's proposed instantiation of the funds-authority procedure that the pinned draft deliberately leaves rail- or deployment-defined. The draft does not reference EMILIA, and no endorsement or adoption is claimed.
claim_boundary.scope: Only the funds-authority clause of Check 8 is instantiated. Receipt availability from the Transparency Service, and Checks 1 through 7 and 9, are out of scope for this vector.
claim_boundary.composition: The Hawkins scope leg and the EMILIA receipt leg stay in their own trust boundaries and join by the scope digest; neither verifier ingests the other's evidence.

scope_model.apk_thumbprint: RFC 9679 COSE Key Thumbprint, SHA-256, required-parameter OKP COSE_Key

receipt_model.verifier: packages/verify verifyReceipt (offline, pinned Ed25519 key per account principal)
receipt_model.revocation: packages/verify EP-REVOCATION-v1 isRevoked under pinned revoker keys

cases.title: The principal receipt names this exact scope digest; the funds-authority clause of Check 8 is established
A valid receipt for a DIFFERENT scope digest does not carry authority for this scope

outcome.detail: receipt authorizes issuance of a different Authorization Scope (join digest differs)

cases.title: No funds-authority receipt available: the check fails closed, never a pass
An expired receipt confers nothing at the executor decision time

outcome.detail: receipt expiry has passed at the executor decision time

cases.title: An authentic pinned-revoker EP-REVOCATION-v1 statement revokes the exact receipt

outcome.detail: an authentic pinned-revoker statement revokes this exact receipt

cases.title: A receipt signed by a key not pinned for the account principal is refused

outcome.detail: receipt signature does not verify under the key pinned for the account principal
